description: Expander for the MIX MUTE and MIX SOLO expanders, turning their mute and unmute switches into timed fades with separate rise and fall times; it goes immediately to the right of one of them

params.text: Sets how long that numbered channel takes to fade in, from 0 to 30 seconds
Sets how long that numbered channel takes to fade out, from 0 to 30 seconds
Sets how long the final mix takes to fade in, from 0 to 30 seconds
Sets how long the final mix takes to fade out, from 0 to 30 seconds
Curves that channel's fade: exponential at full counterclockwise, linear at noon, logarithmic at full clockwise, and a blend in between
Curves the fade of the final mix: exponential at full counterclockwise, linear at noon, logarithmic at full clockwise, and a blend in between

outputs.text: The fade level of that numbered channel as CV, 0V when it is fully muted and 10V when it is fully unmuted
The fade level of the final mix as CV, 0V when it is fully muted and 10V when it is fully unmuted

notes: the mute and unmute switching itself comes from a MIX MUTE or MIX SOLO expander; this module only times the transitions
one fade expander can be used per mix module, and a MIX FADE cannot be used alongside it
the indicator lamp glows yellow once the expander has connected to a mix module
